receipts.receiptText:
77. Rhubarb Chutney.
Make just like apple chutney, only use less vinegar. In addition to the raisins and other ingredients, add a teacupful of finely-minced and blanched almonds. This is worth trying. Less red pepper might be used.

receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt from Lichfield Mercury - Friday 13 March 1914
receipts.receiptText: RHUBARB CHUTNEY. Now that, rhubarb .is coming you really ought to try this delicious chutney. Cut into pieces enough rhubarb to fill cup. Add half cupful water, one and a half cupful of sugar, the pulp and sliced rind of a lemon and orange, a quarter pound each seeded and Cook all over slow fire. Tie down glass jars when thick.
